item.title: Baldwin Commissioners, board of tax assessors agree on need for more dialogue - The Union-Recorder
item.description: When it comes to solving problems between government officials communication always plays a major role in solving differences. Or at least attempting to solve issues.

item.title: Moss delivers student board report - The Union-Recorder
item.description: Sarai Moss captivated a near-capacity crowd of fellow students and parents during the March meeting of the Baldwin County Board of Education.

item.title: MILLIANS: Sports moments I remember - The Union-Recorder
item.description: The recent death of legendary football coach Lou Holtz sent me down memory lane.

item.title: SIMMONS: Why representation matters in House District 149 - The Union-Recorder
item.description: House District 149 did not come into existence by accident. Like many districts across Georgia and the nation, it was created through a redistricting process shaped by history, law, and the long struggle for equal political representation.

item.title: Fuel tax suspension to help Georgia drivers, shoppers as Iran conflict spikes prices - The Union-Recorder
item.description: Georgia drivers should soon see relief at the pump after the Georgia General Assembly sent a temporary gasoline tax suspension to Gov. Brian Kemp.

item.title: Elaine Ellington retires as Hardwick Baptist Church secretary after more than five decades - The Union-Recorder
item.description: Elaine Ellington’s life has been spent caring and loving others just like Jesus Christ instructs all of His children to do. And she’s done most of those things behind church doors.

item.title: Baldwin County grand jury declines to indict - The Union-Recorder
item.description: A Baldwin County grand jury has declined to indict a Milledgeville man on murder charges stemming from a fatal shootout outside a local restaurant last year.

item.title: RICH: Don’t it make you wanna go home? - The Union-Recorder
item.description: Not long ago, I drove home, the back way, from running errands in town.

item.title: GCSU Flannery O’Connor Institute to present screening of ‘Wise Blood’ - The Union-Recorder
item.description: The Flannery O’Connor Institute for the Humanities of Georgia College & State University continues its Southern Gothic film series with a screening of John Huston’s 1979 film, “Wise Blood” in celebration of O’Connor’s 101st birthday.

item.title: Sandersville man arrested on drug charges - The Union-Recorder
item.description: A 64-year-old Sandersville man was arrested March 20 on illegal drug charges, local and state law enforcement authorities say.
